description.zh: 用即时过滤把大列表缩到与当前输入相关的一小部分：用户在搜索框敲字，列表随之实时收窄， 并显示命中数量与空结果提示。它把"查找"变成"修剪"，不用提交、不用等跳转，反馈就在眼前。
description.en: Narrows a large list to whatever matches the current input: every keystroke filters the list in place, with hit counts and an empty-state hint. Finding becomes pruning — no submit, no page jump, feedback stays right in front of the user.

use_when.zh: 列表条目在几十到几百条，一次加载即可全量过滤
use_when.en: Tens to hundreds of items that can be loaded once and filtered client-side

use_when.zh: 用户记得目标的部分名称或标签，扫视比翻页快
use_when.en: Users recall part of a name or tag — scanning beats paging

use_when.zh: 设置、通讯录、组件库等查找型页面
use_when.en: Lookup-heavy pages such as settings, contacts, component libraries

avoid_when.zh: 数据在海量服务端集合上，必须走后端搜索
avoid_when.en: Huge server-side datasets that require backend search

avoid_when.zh: 条目本身无明显关键词可匹配
avoid_when.en: Items with no obvious text or tag to match against

avoid_when.zh: 需要复杂多维条件组合，应交给筛选面板
avoid_when.en: Complex multi-facet conditions belong in a filter panel

note.zh: 输入即过滤，无提交按钮
note.en: Filter on every keystroke, no submit button

note.zh: 点标签按类目过滤，可与搜索叠加
note.en: Category chips that stack with the query

note.zh: 匹配片段标亮，帮助确认为什么命中
note.en: Highlights the matched fragment to justify each hit

notes.zh: 受控输入 + useMemo 过滤（大小写不敏感的 includes 起步），列表项配 transition 或淡入。 显示命中数；零命中展示空状态与清除按钮；命中片段用 mark 或强调色标亮。输入加 type="search" 与 aria-label，防抖仅在触发远端请求时才需要。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
notes.en: A controlled input plus useMemo filtering (case-insensitive includes to start) over items rendered with subtle transitions. Show the hit count; render an empty state with a clear button on zero matches; highlight matched fragments with mark or accent color. Use type="search" with an aria-label; debounce only for remote requests. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

basic.zh: 创建一个搜索筛选（Search Filtering）演示，在输入框打字时列表即时过滤并显示命中数量。
basic.en: Create a search filtering demo where typing instantly filters a list and shows the match count.

design.zh: 创建搜索筛选演示。要求：搜索框实时过滤组件列表，命中片段高亮；显示"共 N 条命中"； 无结果时展示空状态与一键清除；过滤变化有轻微淡入过渡；输入框带清除按钮。
design.en: Create a search filtering demo. Requirements: a search box live-filtering a component list with matched fragments highlighted; a "N matches" counter; an empty state with one-tap clear on zero results; a subtle fade on filter changes; a clear button inside the input.

implementation.zh: 用 React 实现 Search Filtering：useState 保存关键词，useMemo 做大小写不敏感过滤， 命中片段用 split + mark 高亮。列表项显示名称与标签，空结果渲染空状态组件。 不引入搜索库，动画尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。
implementation.en: Implement Search Filtering in React: keep the query in useState, filter in useMemo case-insensitively, and highlight matches via split + mark. Items show name and tags; render an empty state on zero hits. No search library; respect prefers-reduced-motion.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现搜索筛选（Search Filtering）。

先检查现有列表与搜索输入组件，优先复用。
用途：设置页的配置项查找。
要求：
- 输入即时过滤，无提交按钮
- 显示命中数量，空结果给空状态与清除入口
- 命中片段高亮
- 不新增搜索类依赖
完成后运行项目现有检查，并列出修改的文件。
agent.en:
Implement search filtering in the current project.

Inspect existing list and search input components first; reuse them.
Usage: finding settings entries.
Requirements:
- Instant filtering on input, no submit button
- Match count plus an empty state with clear entry on zero hits
- Matched fragments highlighted
- No search-specific dependencies
Run existing project checks when done and list the modified files.
